safety.confirmBody: ScanIQ flagged this payload as potentially dangerous. Visiting it or executing it could expose you to phishing, quishing, malware, credential theft, or fraud. Proceed only if you trust the source and have reviewed the investigation report.

privacy.title: Privacy Principles
privacy.subtitle: ScanIQ OSINT is built for privacy-conscious investigators.
privacy.localDataBody: All cases, scans, investigations, and notes are stored locally on your device using IndexedDB. Nothing is uploaded unless you explicitly click an external lookup AND have opted into network sources.
privacy.cameraBody: The camera runs exclusively on-device. Frames are decoded locally and never recorded, stored, or transmitted.
privacy.noTrackingBody: Anonymous app health telemetry is OPT-IN and disabled by default. Content of cases or payloads is never telemetered.
privacy.clearDataBody: Wipe everything via Privacy & Settings → Destructive actions. Uninstalling removes all on-device data.

onboarding.slide1Body: Every QR and barcode is decoded purely on your device. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you explicitly opt in.
onboarding.slide2Body: Payload analysis, URL deconstruction, explainable risk scores with evidence, redirect chains, reputation, DNS/RDAP/ASN/Geo — all in a dedicated case file.
onboarding.slide3Body: No paywalls, no Pro tiers, no lock-in. All sources are user-controlled opt-in. Your threat-intel workflow, your rules.
